title: CNC V-grooving machines

about_title: Sharp, zero-radius bends in stainless and aluminum
about_text: NovoTech's value line is our own brand: machines built in China to our specification with European and Japanese controls and hydraulics — Delem, Estun, Hawe, Rexroth, Schneider, Siemens, NOK — inspected before they ship and sold under NovoTech's name with the same CSA-approved panel, 1-year warranty and parts and technical support from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada, as every machine we sell.

A V-grooving machine planes a V-shaped channel along the bend line so the sheet folds to a sharp outside corner with no springback and no damage to the finish — the way stainless elevator and door panels, column cladding, signage and architectural trim are made. The horizontal machines lay the sheet flat on a 10.5 to 20 ft table with a four-tool servo head at up to 295 ft/min; the vertical machines stand the sheet against a fixed beam in half the floor space and groove plate to 1/4″. Taiwan CNC and servos, ± 0.01 mm positioning, hydraulic clamping that does not mark the sheet.
